data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ier total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: יִיר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Ier is derived from the Hebrew word יִיר (yir), which means 'mountain of the LORD.' This name is often associated with the biblical city of Jerusalem, which was known as the City of God and the Mountain of the LORD in ancient times.

in_greek.name: Ἰερ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Ier in Greek is translated as 'priest.' This name is derived from the Greek word ἱερός (hieros), which means 'sacred, holy, or priestly.'

in_latin.name: Ier
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ier in Latin is the same as in English and Greek, meaning 'priest.'
